newsitem.title: USA: MidAmerican files IES merger plan with FERC.
newsitem.headline: MidAmerican files IES merger plan with FERC.

text.p: MidAmerican Energy Co said Monday it filed an application with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC), seeking approval of its proposed merger with IES Industries Inc.
IES, which has rejected MidAmerican's unsolicited bid, has agreed to merge with WPL Holdings Inc and Interstate Power Co.

In its FERC application, MidAmerican proposes to freeze electric prices for wholesale customers of both MidAmerican and IES for four years, it said. MidAmerican also proposes a one-year freeze on electric transmission prices for customers who take advantage of its open-access transmission tariff.

MidAmerican said its point-to-point electric transmission prices are about 30 percent lower than current IES transmission prices. Upon completion of the merger, those lower prices would be available to IES transmission customers.
MidAmerican previously said it filed a plan with the Iowa Utilities Board that would reduce or freeze prices for its retail electric customers in that state through 2001.
